selectionNotes: Interactive Server/SignalR; server policy, separate from browser retry.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: ConfigureConnection is in ASP.NET Core 11; use the matching runtime.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Matching Web SDK, Razor/reference packs and browser assets; pinned RC2 verifies the canonical sample.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical language mode; no C# 15-specific syntax is needed.

prerequisites: Use Web SDK net11.0, AddRazorComponents/AddInteractiveServerComponents and AddInteractiveServerRenderMode. The pinned SDK resolves Internal.Assets 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105; no external package/provider/account/workload. Match runtime and browser assets.

Require endpoint authorization and an authentication ticket with expiry. The Development-only loopback fixture issues a fictional 25-second cookie, disables sliding expiry and uses ephemeral Data Protection. Replace sign-in and keys for a real application.
Permit WebSockets throughout browser/proxy/server. The example deliberately removes fallback; keep required alternatives in a consumer. The browser observer only makes closure visible.
Choose finite buffering thresholds from workload measurements. This sample uses 8192/16384 bytes and separately permits 65536-byte SignalR receive messages. Transient cargo state is not persisted.
constraints: Interactive Server/SignalR; distinct from browser reconnect options.

CloseOnAuthenticationExpiration closes an existing transport after ticket expiry is observed; it does not renew sign-in, continuously check revocation or guarantee an exact deadline. New connections still need authorization.

Pipe thresholds apply backpressure, not message rejection or a hard memory cap. The successful 27648-character real circuit relay exceeds both thresholds; no slow-reader, load, throughput or memory-capacity claim.

The executed .NET 10 endpoint-metadata convention is a previous-release comparison, not an older-target ConfigureConnection route. Traditional MapBlazorHub configuration is a different hosting shape; do not duplicate a Web App hub mapping.

Actual Windows/Chrome loopback evidence only. Static SSR has no circuit; WebAssembly/Auto, other authentication providers, proxies, distributed hosting and GA are unverified. No auth-refresh or pause policy is supplied.

evidence.scope: Actual pinned Web SDK compilation. Separate real Chrome/cookie-auth circuit execution verifies WebSocket upgrade, fallback rejection, a 27648-character roundtrip above both pipe thresholds, expiry closure and expiry-disabled controls. Exact inputs/artifacts in docs/verification/PIN-790.md; no mocks, cross-compilation or load/memory-capacity claim.
